findings: The 6 mm qualification does not prove passage through the annulus bore and square plate hole. `six_mm_pin_complete_downward_passage` checks only the pin's final world-Z position, while `six_mm_pin_washer_contact_samples == 0` checks only absence of washer contact; there is no XY/axis-alignment or orientation bound during the crossing window. A pin deflected or tipped around the outside of the 50 mm fixture could satisfy both checks. Derive the aperture-crossing window from native poses and require the pin to remain within the geometric clearance and sufficiently upright while its body traverses both the washer and plate planes; preserve those measurements in the trace/report.
